title: Binance Launches Portfolio Accounts: Industry-First Technological Solution for Trading Teams
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to introduce Portfolio Accounts, the industry’s first crypto exchange solution built to enable trading teams to pool their investors’ assets based on trading strategies. Leveraging Binance’s advanced technology and robust account management infrastructure, Portfolio Accounts streamlines operations and enhances trading efficiency by allowing trading teams to consolidate investor assets into omnibus accounts and manage trading strategies seamlessly.  About Portfolio Accounts Built with traditional finance infrastructure in mind, this innovative solution enables trading teams to consolidate externally-raised investor assets into one or multiple omnibus accounts (“Portfolio Accounts”). As such, trading teams are able to focus on trading while managing portfolios and performance reporting seamlessly. Investors and trading teams would have entered into their own separate agreement regarding subscription and redemption. Investors can redeem their share of assets as per the agreed terms. Benefits of Portfolio Accounts Streamlined portfolio management:  Portfolio Accounts enable the consolidation of investor assets into a single omnibus account, reducing operational complexity and enabling more efficient strategy execution for trading teams. Flexibility in strategy execution:  Trading teams can create multiple portfolio accounts, allowing for diverse trading strategies while maintaining a centralized structure and reducing operational overheads. NAV-Based Portfolio Valuation:  Portfolio Accounts adopt a NAV per unit concept, common in traditional finance (TradFi), providing clear and trackable metrics for each portfolio. This standardizes crypto asset management, allowing trading teams and investors to accurately track their entitlements in the respective portfolio accounts. Investor diversification:  By setting up multiple  portfolio  accounts, trading teams can more easily serve a diverse range of investors based on risk levels and tailor trading strategies accordingly. Building Trust Between Trading Teams and Investors:  Binance's robust account management system ensures secure asset storage and offers trading teams the flexibility for efficient trading, fostering trust in the crypto asset management industry and easing entry for new trading teams. Scaling Business Growth:  Trading teams can expand portfolio size without additional operational costs by pooling assets, simplifying the scaling of digital asset investments previously hindered by complex, costly separate account management. Getting Started With Portfolio Accounts Eligible trading teams interested in gaining access to Portfolio Accounts can contact us via our  contact form  or by reaching out to their Binance VIP representative.  Note:  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support!
